name: isDesktopAppStatusRestricted
definition: The IDrive client configuration is provisioned in thin-client mode: the decoded configuration_id token carries desktopAppStatus false, so end users are restricted from pausing or changing backups in the desktop app.
population: the one client configuration token returned by getConfigurationId
evidenceRequiredForTrue: configuration_id present, decodes to JSON with a desktopAppStatus field, and that field is falsy

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: Reads the default client configuration token, not each enrolled device.
